properties.name: Modifiers
properties.summary: Child modifiers applied in order. The tag parameter is split by;, with the n-th segment passed to the n-th child; absent segments deliver so the child falls back to its own defaults.
properties.remarks: Direct list mutation does not notify the owning component — use [[SetModifiers]], [[AddModifier]], [[RemoveModifierAt]], or call uniText.SetDirty(UniTextDirtyFlags.Text) manually so the new child set is re-initialised and re-applied in the next parse pass.

types.name: EffectModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that append duplicate glyph geometry behind or in front of the face (outline, shadow, extrude, glow, custom effects).
types.remarks: Contract: During onGlyph, the subclass's [[OnGlyphEffect]] decides whether the current glyph needs an effect quad and, if so, calls [[EnqueueDuplicate]] with an arbitrary payload integer — typically an index into the modifier's own per-emit data table. The [[currentEffectPass]] in effect at enqueue time is captured and decides whether the duplicate lands before or after the face block. At onMainPassFinalize, the per-modifier emit queue is flushed via [[OnFlush]]. The default implementation reserves 4 vertices and 6 indices for each pending emit (copying source geometry, queueing triangles) and then calls [[OnEmitQuad]] so the subclass can fill colour, UV2, offsets — anything the effect needs. Multi-layer effects override [[OnFlush]] to flush per-layer buffers in layer-major order. Painter order is preserved by per-modifier grouping: onMainPassFinalize flushes each modifier in registration order, so all of one modifier's quads land contiguously in the index buffer ahead of the next modifier's quads, ahead of the face block (or after, when [[PostFace]] was active). The base class deliberately knows nothing about colour, dilate, softness, offsets, gradients, or any effect-specific parameter. Those live entirely inside the subclass. Common write patterns (solid colour + UV2, per-vertex gradient, offset, expand) are exposed via the static [[EffectQuadOps]] helpers so subclasses share the implementation without sharing the data layout.

methods.name: OnGlyphEffect
methods.summary: Called once per glyph during mesh generation. The subclass decides whether the current glyph ([[currentCluster]]) needs an effect quad and invokes [[EnqueueDuplicate]] if so. Emoji glyphs must be skipped (uniText.MeshGenerator.font.IsColor).

methods.name: OnEmitQuad
methods.summary: Writes the actual per-vertex data into a reserved effect-quad slot. The base has already copied geometry (positions, UV0, UV1) from the source face quad and queued the triangle indices; destBaseIdx points at the first of the four duplicate vertices. The subclass writes [[Colors]], [[Uvs2]], and (if needed) re-positions [[Vertices]] through [[EffectQuadOps]] helpers.

params.name: sourceBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the source face quad — read-only reference for alpha modulation, gradient evaluation, etc.

params.name: destBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the reserved effect quad — destination of all writes.

params.name: payload
params.description: Arbitrary subclass-defined tag captured at [[EnqueueDuplicate]] time.

methods.name: ResetOwnRequests
methods.summary: Resets per-cycle emit state. Subclasses with extra buffers (e.g. multi-layer effects) override and chain to clear their own storage.

methods.name: EnqueueDuplicate
methods.summary: Queues a duplicate of the given face quad for emission at onMainPassFinalize. The duplicate will land in the index buffer according to the current [[currentEffectPass]].

params.name: sourceBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the source face quad (use gen.faceBaseIdx).

params.name: payload
params.description: Arbitrary integer carried verbatim into [[OnEmitQuad]]. Typically an index into a per-emit table the subclass maintains alongside its per-range data.

methods.name: OnFlush
methods.summary: Flushes the pending emit queue. Default implementation processes [[emits]] in the order they were enqueued — correct for single-layer effects. Multi-layer effects (e.g. extrude) override and iterate their own per-layer buffers in layer-major order, calling [[ReserveQuad]] + [[OnEmitQuad]] directly.

methods.name: ReserveQuad
methods.summary: Reserves a 4-vertex / 6-index effect-quad slot: copies positions, UV0 and UV1 from the source quad, queues a triangle pair into the shared pre/post-face buffer matching pass, and advances [[vertexCount]].
methods.remarks: [[Colors]] and [[Uvs2]] are not initialised here — the subclass writes both in [[OnEmitQuad]] via the [[EffectQuadOps]] helpers. Leaving them untouched keeps the base ignorant of per-effect data layout.
methods.returns: First vertex index of the new quad.

types.name: EffectPass
types.summary: Layering of an [[EffectModifier]] duplicate quad relative to the face within the SDF mesh. Effect modifiers read [[currentEffectPass]] when a quad is enqueued and route its triangles into the matching pass buffer.
types.remarks: [[PreFace]] — triangles are prepended to the index buffer so the face draws on top of the duplicate (standard outline / shadow / extrude behavior under glyphs). [[PostFace]] — triangles are appended after the face so the duplicate draws on top of the face (used by overlay decoration lines whose effects must sit above text).

types.name: EffectQuadOps
types.summary: Static helpers for writing per-vertex effect data into a reserved effect-quad slot. Used from [[OnEmitQuad]] implementations; covers the common solid-colour + UV2 path and the per-vertex gradient path. Modifiers with bespoke requirements can skip these helpers and write the vertex arrays directly.

methods.name: ModulateAlpha
methods.summary: Modulates an effect colour's alpha by the source face vertex alpha — the canonical formula keeping outline / shadow / extrude fades synchronised with face fades (Graphic.color.a, per-character <alpha>, ColorModifier alpha).

methods.name: WriteSolidEffect
methods.summary: Writes a single effect colour (per-vertex alpha-modulated by the source face vertex alpha) into the four destination vertex colours and stamps UV2 with the effect-mode flag plus dilate / softness. Covers outline / shadow / extrude-layer "solid colour" use cases.

methods.name: WriteGradientEffect
methods.summary: Evaluates a gradient at each of the four destination vertex positions and writes the per-vertex colours (alpha-modulated by the corresponding source face vertex alpha) plus the effect-mode UV2 stamp. Vertex positions are read from [[Vertices]] at destBaseIdx, so the caller controls whether the gradient sees pre-offset positions (write before [[ApplyOffset]]) or post-offset positions (write after).

methods.name: WriteEffectUV2
methods.summary: Stamps the effect-mode UV2 layout into all four destination vertices: x = dilate, y = 1 (per-quad effect-mode flag the shader branches on), z = 0 (reserved), w = softness.

methods.name: ApplyOffset
methods.summary: Displaces all four destination vertices in the X/Y plane. Z is left untouched.

types.name: EllipsisModifier
types.summary: Truncates text that overflows its container and appends an ellipsis (...).
types.remarks: Parameter: optional position (0-1) controlling where the ellipsis appears: - 0: Truncates from the start, ellipsis at the beginning - 0.5: Truncates from the middle, ellipsis in the center - 1 (default): Truncates from the end, ellipsis at the end The modifier automatically detects overflow based on container height (with word wrap) or width (without word wrap) and uses binary search to find the optimal truncation point.

types.name: EmptyModifier
types.summary: A no-op modifier that performs no action.
types.remarks: Used as a placeholder or for tags that should be parsed but have no visual effect. Can be associated with custom parse rules to extract data without modifying rendering.

types.name: ExtrudeModifier
types.summary: Adds a 3D extrude/bevel effect by appending a stack of progressively offset duplicate quads behind the face.
types.remarks: Layers are flushed back-to-front in layer-major order across all glyphs (every glyph's deepest slice first, then every glyph's next-deeper slice, …, then face). Naïve per-glyph fanout would invert that order at glyph boundaries when the cumulative offset exceeds glyph advance, leaving farther slices of glyph N+1 covering closer slices of glyph N. Per-layer buffers preserve the painter order regardless of overlap. Format: <extrude=offsetX,offsetY,#nearColor,#farColor,dilate,softness>. Defaults: offset = (3,-3), near = white, far = black, dilate = 0, softness = 0.

methods.name: OnFlush
methods.summary: Layer-major flush: every glyph's deepest slice first, then every glyph's next slice, …, then the face. Each layer maintains its own emit buffer, so painter order survives inter-glyph overlap when the cumulative extrusion offset exceeds glyph advance.

methods.name: OnEmitQuad
methods.summary: Not used — [[ExtrudeModifier]] bypasses the base emit-queue indirection and writes all per-layer slots directly inside its [[OnFlush]] override.

properties.name: Steps
properties.summary: Number of extrude layers stacked behind the face (minimum 1). More layers produce a smoother depth gradient and a longer apparent extrusion at the cost of additional duplicate-quad geometry per glyph.

properties.name: Bevel
properties.summary: When, layers alternate between the near and far face colours rather than blending across, producing a faceted bevel highlight. The layer count effectively doubles ([[Steps]] × 2) because each step contributes a near face and a side face.

properties.name: FixedPixelSize
properties.summary: When, the per-range offsetX / offsetY / dilate / softness values are interpreted in fixed pixels and compensated by the glyph metric factor so the extrusion has constant on-screen geometry independent of font size.

types.name: FontModifier
types.summary: Overrides the font used for a text range by selecting a [[FontFamily]] from the component's [[UniTextFontStack]] by its [[name]].
types.remarks: Parameter: the target family name (case-sensitive). Example: <font=pixel>Score</font>. Priority: a matched font wins over [[preferredLanguage]] selection and over the regular FontStack fallback chain. If the chosen family's primary lacks a glyph for a codepoint, the normal fallback chain still kicks in for that codepoint. If the name is not found in the FontStack, a warning is logged once per unresolved name and affected codepoints render with the default fallback behavior.

types.name: GlobalSettingsGradientProvider
types.summary: [[IGradientProvider]] backed by the project-wide [[Gradients]] asset. Use this when the same gradient catalog is shared across all UniText components in the project.
types.remarks: Listens to both [[Changed]] (in case the project-wide asset pointer is reassigned) and the bound asset's own [[Changed]] event (in case its entries are edited). Both subscriptions are lazy and tied to this provider's own [[Changed]] subscriber count, so an unused provider doesn't keep itself alive through the settings/asset delegate lists.

types.name: GlyphModifier<T>
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that store per-glyph attribute data.
types.remarks: GlyphModifier provides automatic buffer management for per-glyph attributes. Derived classes implement [[GetOnGlyphCallback]] to receive callbacks during mesh generation, where they can modify vertex data based on attribute values. Optionally override [[GetOnShapedCallback]] to also receive a callback after shaping completes, for modifying glyph advances or run widths.

methods.name: DoApply
methods.summary: Implements the modifier's effect on the specified range. Buffer is guaranteed to have sufficient capacity when this is called.

methods.name: GetOnShapedCallback
methods.summary: Returns a callback to invoke after shaping completes. Override to modify glyph advances or run widths. Returns null by default (no shaped callback).

types.name: GradientGeometry
types.summary: Per-text-range precomputed gradient geometry consumed by gradient-aware modifiers ([[GradientModifier]], [[OutlineModifier]]).
types.remarks: Filled once per layout cycle by [[Precompute]] from the range's glyph bounding boxes; queried per glyph by [[EvaluateColor]] to map a vertex position to a gradient t and the resulting [[Color32]].

types.name: GradientModifier
types.summary: Applies gradient coloring to text ranges using named gradients.
types.remarks: Parameter format: name[,shape][,angle] rainbow — linear gradient, angle 0 rainbow,linear,45 — linear at 45° rainbow,radial — radial gradient from center rainbow,angular — angular (conic) sweep from top rainbow,angular,90 — angular sweep rotated 90° Shape controls the gradient form: linear (projection onto an axis), radial (distance from center), or angular (conic sweep). The set of named gradients available to <gradient=name> tags is supplied by an [[IGradientProvider]]. The default provider resolves names through the project-wide [[Gradients]] asset; alternative providers allow per-component asset references or inline catalogs edited on the modifier itself.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named gradients used by this modifier when resolving <gradient=name> tags. disables resolution and causes such tags to be skipped with a warning.
properties.remarks: The provider is consulted in OnApply (text-attribute pass), so swapping it requeues a re-parse via [[Text]] — existing gradient definitions cached in the shared attribute data are discarded and rebuilt against the new provider.

types.name: GradientUtil
types.summary: Helpers for precomputing and evaluating gradient geometry. Shared between [[GradientModifier]] (face colour) and effect modifiers that support gradients (currently [[OutlineModifier]]); custom modifiers can use them too.

methods.name: Precompute
methods.summary: Precomputes the projection / centre / radius for a single gradient range from its glyph bounding boxes. Call once per layout cycle.

methods.name: EvaluateT
methods.summary: Maps a vertex position to a gradient t in [0, 1] using precomputed geometry.

methods.name: EvaluateColor
methods.summary: Evaluates the gradient at a vertex position and returns a [[Color32]] whose alpha has been multiplied by alphaModulator (typically the source vertex's alpha byte, so the gradient inherits face fades).

types.name: IAttributeData
types.summary: Interface for custom attribute data stored in [[UniTextBuffers]].
types.remarks: Implement this interface to create custom per-text attribute storage for modifiers. Use [[GetOrCreateAttributeData{T}]] to retrieve instances.

methods.name: Release
methods.summary: Releases all pooled resources back to the pool.

types.name: IGradientProvider
types.summary: Resolves named [[NamedGradient]] entries for [[GradientModifier]].
types.remarks: Marker interface over [[INamedCatalog{TEntry}]] — exists to scope the [SerializeReference, TypeSelector] dropdown and to give a domain-specific name. Built-in implementations: [[InlineGradientProvider]], [[AssetGradientProvider]], [[GlobalSettingsGradientProvider]]. Custom providers should raise their [[Changed]] event whenever their resolution result changes.

types.name: IHasGradientProvider
types.summary: Implemented by modifiers that own an [[IGradientProvider]] the editor can surface as the source of the enum:@gradients dropdown. Lets the dropdown content follow the per-modifier provider regardless of which modifier type carries the parameter ([[GradientModifier]], [[OutlineModifier]], or any future modifier that opts into gradient-coloured output).

properties.name: GradientProvider
properties.summary: The gradient provider whose entries should populate the enum:@gradients dropdown when this modifier is selected in the inspector. falls back to the project-wide [[Gradients]] asset.

types.name: IndentModifier
types.summary: Adds left indentation that begins where the tag opens and persists across wrapped lines until the tag closes.
types.remarks: Two complementary mechanisms produce a continuous visual indent: Every line whose first codepoint falls inside the tagged range is pushed right by the resolved value (line-start margin). If the tag opens in the middle of a line (i.e. the codepoint preceding the tag is not a mandatory line break), the advance of that previous codepoint is widened by the indent so that content following the open boundary visibly shifts right within the current line. As soon as the tag closes, subsequent codepoints carry no extra indent, so the next line wraps back to the container edge. Indents from overlapping or nested ranges accumulate, so writing <indent=1em>outer <indent=1em>inner</indent></indent> indents the inner content by two ems. Negative values pull the line back, which can be used to outdent a nested run or to balance an outer indent. Parameter — single value with optional unit: 20 or 20px — layout units; like every other UniText geometric modifier these scale together with auto-sized text. 1.5em — multiplied by the current shaping font size. 10% — fraction of the host RectTransform's width, resolved into render space using the active glyph scale so the on-screen indent stays at the requested percentage with or without auto-size. Ignored when the rect has no finite width. +5 / -5 — explicit delta. Functionally identical to the unsigned form because indents always compose additively.

types.name: InlineGradientProvider
types.summary: [[IGradientProvider]] with an inline list of named gradients edited directly on the modifier. Use this for one-off catalogs that don't deserve a dedicated asset and aren't shared across components.

types.name: InlineMedia
types.summary: Common entry-data base for inline-flowed media ([[InlineSprite]], [[InlineObject]]). Carries the name and layout metrics that both shape (advance, bearing) and rendering (width, height) need; the renderable payload is added by the concrete subclass.
types.remarks: All metrics are in em units (relative to fontSize): width=1, height=1 means the media is fontSize x fontSize pixels advance=1 means the cursor moves by fontSize pixels after this media bearingX/bearingY are offsets relative to fontSize

methods.name: UpdateInstances
methods.summary: Trims excess wrappers when fewer occurrences are active than instances exist, then runs [[Setup]] on every remaining instance to apply pending transform/content updates. Called per frame after the mesh rebuild.

fields.name: name
fields.summary: Lookup name used in the tag parameter (e.g. jump in <sprite=jump>). Case-insensitive.

fields.name: width
fields.summary: Width in em units (1 = fontSize).

fields.name: height
fields.summary: Height in em units (1 = fontSize).

fields.name: bearingX
fields.summary: Horizontal offset in em units.

fields.name: bearingY
fields.summary: Vertical offset in em units.

fields.name: advance
fields.summary: Advance width in em units (1 = fontSize).

fields.name: activeCount
fields.summary: Number of on-screen occurrences claimed in the current rebuild pass; reset to 0 on every rebuild start.

types.name: InlineMediaModifier<TEntry, TWrapper>
types.summary: Shared base for modifiers that embed inline-flowed media (prefab instances, sprite quads, future GPU mesh subitems) into text. Subclasses pick the entry type and wrapper type, supply a typed provider field, and translate entries into wrapper state — the base owns the cluster mapping, shape/render passes, lifecycle of wrapper instances, and provider event subscription.

typeParameters.name: TWrapper
typeParameters.description: The [[MediaWrapper]] subclass that materialises each on-screen occurrence.

methods.name: ConfigureWrapper
methods.summary: Copies the per-frame visual state from entry into wrapper (sprite/color, prefab reference, etc.). cluster is the source-text cluster index of this occurrence — subclasses use it to apply per-occurrence overrides parsed by [[OnExtraTokens]] from extra tag arguments.

methods.name: HasRenderable
methods.summary: Returns when the entry's renderable payload is present (sprite assigned, prefab assigned). Entries failing this check are skipped at render time but still influence layout.
methods.remarks: Invoked from the parallel mesh-generation phase, so implementations MUST be worker-thread safe — use is not null reference checks rather than Unity's overloaded != null, which calls EnsureRunningOnMainThread and throws off the main thread. Destroyed Unity assets are filtered correctly later by the main-thread MediaWrapper.TryCreate path.

methods.name: OnExtraTokens
methods.summary: Hook for parsing additional comma-separated arguments after the entry name in a tag (e.g. the i in <sprite=name,i>). Called once per applied range with the cluster index and a reader positioned right after the name token. Empty extras means no extra arguments were supplied — subclasses should clear any stale per-cluster state in that case so previous-rebuild overrides do not persist when the tag is later edited to drop the extras.

methods.name: RebindCatalog
methods.summary: Re-subscribes a swapped provider when the modifier is currently active. Concrete subclasses call this from the Provider property setter.

properties.name: Catalog
properties.summary: The catalog this modifier consults. Concrete subclass exposes a typed provider field with the appropriate marker interface.

types.name: InlineObject
types.summary: Defines an inline object (UI prefab) that can be embedded within text flow.
types.remarks: Pure data: the host [[ObjModifier]] owns lifecycle state (instance count, instantiated prefab clones), so the same [[InlineObject]] instance can safely be referenced by multiple modifiers.

fields.name: prefab
fields.summary: UI prefab to instantiate as the inline child.

types.name: InlineObjProvider
types.summary: [[IObjProvider]] with an inline list of [[InlineObject]] entries edited directly on the modifier. Use this for one-off catalogs that don't deserve a dedicated asset and aren't shared across components.

types.name: InlineSprite
types.summary: Defines an inline sprite that can be embedded within text flow.
types.remarks: Pure data: the host [[SpriteModifier]] owns lifecycle state (instance count, generated GameObjects), so the same [[InlineSprite]] instance can safely be referenced by multiple modifiers.

fields.name: sprite
fields.summary: The sprite to draw.

fields.name: color
fields.summary: Tint color multiplied with the sprite.

fields.name: preserveAspect
fields.summary: If true, the sprite is letterboxed inside the width x height box to keep its native aspect ratio.

types.name: InlineSpriteProvider
types.summary: [[ISpriteProvider]] with an inline list of [[InlineSprite]] entries edited directly on the modifier. Use this for one-off catalogs that don't deserve a dedicated asset and aren't shared across components.

types.name: InteractiveModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that create interactive (clickable/hoverable) text ranges.
types.remarks: Inherit from this class to create custom interactive modifiers like links, hashtags, mentions, or any other clickable text elements. This class automatically: Registers/unregisters with [[InteractiveRangeRegistry]] Stores ranges in a [[PooledArrayAttribute{T}]] Delegates click/hover events to subclass implementations

methods.name: AddRange
methods.summary: Adds an interactive range for the specified text region.

methods.name: HandleRangeClicked
methods.summary: Called when the user clicks on a range owned by this modifier.

methods.name: HandleRangeEntered
methods.summary: Called when the pointer enters a range owned by this modifier (desktop only).

methods.name: HandleRangeExited
methods.summary: Called when the pointer exits a range owned by this modifier (desktop only).

properties.name: Highlighter
properties.summary: Gets or sets the per-modifier text highlighter. When null, the global UniText highlighter is used as fallback.

properties.name: RangeType
properties.summary: Gets the type identifier for ranges created by this modifier.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Gets the priority for overlap resolution. Higher values win.

types.name: IObjProvider
types.summary: Resolves named [[InlineObject]] entries for [[ObjModifier]].
types.remarks: Marker interface over [[INamedCatalog{TEntry}]] — exists to scope the [SerializeReference, TypeSelector] dropdown and to give a domain-specific name. Built-in implementations: [[InlineObjProvider]], [[AssetObjProvider]]. Custom providers should raise their [[Changed]] event whenever their resolution result changes.

types.name: ISpriteProvider
types.summary: Resolves named [[InlineSprite]] entries for [[SpriteModifier]].
types.remarks: Marker interface over [[INamedCatalog{TEntry}]] — exists to scope the [SerializeReference, TypeSelector] dropdown and to give a domain-specific name. Built-in implementations: [[InlineSpriteProvider]], [[AssetSpriteProvider]]. Custom providers should raise their [[Changed]] event whenever their resolution result changes.

types.name: ItalicModifier
types.summary: Applies italic styling to text by shearing glyph vertices.
types.remarks: No parameter. The italic effect is achieved by horizontally shearing the glyph vertices. The shear angle is determined by the font's ItalicStyle property (default 12 degrees).

types.name: LanguageModifier
types.summary: Applies a BCP 47 language tag to a text range for OpenType-aware shaping.
types.remarks: The language tag is forwarded to HarfBuzz as hb_language_t, which drives the OpenType locl (Localized Forms) GSUB feature. This is essential for pan-CJK fonts such as Noto Sans CJK and Source Han Sans, where a single code point renders with different region-specific glyphs (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean) depending on the language tag. Common tags: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh-HK, ja, ko, en, ar, he. HarfBuzz converts BCP 47 to OpenType language tags automatically (zh-Hans → ZHS, ja → JAN, etc.). Apply to the entire text via RangeRule ("..") for a global default, or per-range via the rich-text tag <lang=zh-Hans>...</lang> for mixed-language content.

types.name: LetterSpacingModifier
types.summary: Applies character spacing (tracking) adjustments to text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: spacing value with unit. 10 — add 10 pixels between characters -5 — reduce spacing by 5 pixels 0.5em — add 0.5 em (relative to font size) For cursive joining scripts (Arabic, Syriac, N'Ko, Adlam, etc.), visual kashida (tatweel) bars are rendered between connected letter pairs using 9-slice SDF rendering, preserving the appearance of cursive connections at any spacing value.

types.name: LineHeightModifier
types.summary: Adjusts line height for text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: line height value with optional unit. 1.5 or 150% — 150% of default line height 40 — absolute 40 pixels (replaces default) +10 — add 10 pixels to base (default or absolute) -5 — reduce by 5 pixels When multiple overlapping ranges set an absolute height, the largest absolute wins and serves as the base for any delta or multiplier on the same line.

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.summary: Emits one decoration-line quad spanning [startX, endX] at baselineY + lineYOffset, sampling the underscore SDF column described by [uvLeft, uvRight] (use centerX..centerX for stretch segments and -sdfPadding..centerX / centerX..aspect+sdfPadding for end caps).

params.name: thickness
params.description: Full visible line thickness in pixels (post.underlineThickness or OS/2.yStrikeoutSize at this font size). NaN falls back to the underscore glyph's natural rendered height. The quad height equals this thickness; SDF samples the full ink span vertically with a small padding margin for AA at top/bottom edges, so visible thickness scales linearly with the parameter regardless of underscore aspect.

methods.name: DrawDot
methods.summary: Emits one dot quad centered at (centerX, baselineY + lineYOffset), sized dotSize * aspect × dotSize where aspect is the bullet glyph's natural width/height ratio (typically ≈1). Samples the bullet glyph (U+2022) so the SDF gives a true round shape with antialiased edge. Falls back to a square dotSize×dotSize stretched-underscore mark when the resolved font has no bullet glyph or the atlas entry is missing.

types.name: LineStyle
types.summary: Visual style of decoration lines (CSS Text Decoration Module Level 4: text-decoration-style).

types.name: LinkModifier
types.summary: Modifier that creates clickable hyperlinks in text.
types.remarks: Applies link styling (color and optional underline) to text ranges and handles click events. Parameter: URL string. Subscribe to [[LinkClicked]] to handle link clicks, or let the modifier open URLs automatically via [[OpenURL]].
types.example:
var linkMod = uniText.GetModifier<LinkModifier>();
linkMod.LinkClicked += url => Debug.Log($"Link clicked: {url}");

properties.name: LinkColor
properties.summary: Gets or sets the color applied to link text.

properties.name: EnableUnderline
properties.summary: Gets or sets whether underline decoration is enabled.

properties.name: AutoOpenUrl
properties.summary: Gets or sets whether URLs are opened automatically on click.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.summary: Raised when a link is clicked, providing the URL.

events.name: LinkEntered
events.summary: Raised when the pointer enters a link, providing the URL.

events.name: LinkExited
events.summary: Raised when the pointer exits a link.

types.name: ListItemInfo
types.summary: Contains information about a single list item for rendering.

types.name: ListMarkerPlacement
types.summary: Controls how the list marker is placed relative to the content.

fields.name: Inside
fields.summary: Marker takes inline space at the line start; content begins immediately past the marker, so items with different marker widths (e.g. 1. and 10.) start at different positions. Default — matches Google Docs, MS Word, and Discord visual behavior. Equivalent to CSS list-style-position: inside. Direction-aware: the marker sits on the leading side of the line for both LTR and RTL paragraphs.

fields.name: Outside
fields.summary: Marker is aligned against a fixed content column — its trailing edge meets the content start, so all items have content at the same position regardless of marker width. Markers wider than the reserved column hang past the line start into the leading margin (left in LTR paragraphs, right in RTL). Equivalent to CSS list-style-position: outside. Use when a strictly aligned content column is required and the indent is wide enough to fit the widest marker.

types.name: ListModifier
types.summary: Renders list markers (bullets or numbers) for text items with automatic indentation.
types.remarks: Parameter: optional level:number for numbered lists. Without parameter, renders a bullet. Features: - Supports nested lists with configurable indentation per level - Bullet markers are customizable per nesting level - Ordered lists support decimal, alphabetic, and Roman numeral styles - Automatically handles RTL text direction

methods.name: SetBulletMarkers
methods.summary: Replaces the bullet-marker glyphs for every nesting level. Null or empty input is rejected (a list must have at least one entry, used for every level).

params.name: markers
params.description: New marker glyphs ordered by nesting level.

methods.name: SetOrderedStyles
methods.summary: Replaces the per-level numbering styles for ordered lists.

params.name: styles
params.description: New marker styles ordered by nesting level.

properties.name: MarkerPlacement
properties.summary: How the marker is placed relative to the content. [[Inside]] (default) renders the marker inline at the start of the line; each nested item is indented by its own ancestors' marker widths, so a nested marker lines up with its parent's content regardless of unrelated siblings — matches Google Docs, MS Word, and Discord. [[Outside]] reserves a fixed content column derived from the widest marker in the list, so all items have content aligned at the same column regardless of marker width.
properties.remarks: Read in the shape phase (OnShaped) to compute start-line margins; changing it requeues a re-parse via [[Text]] so the new margins flow into line breaking.

properties.name: BulletMarkers
properties.summary: Bullet marker glyphs indexed by nesting level (level 0 first). When a list item nests deeper than the configured length, the last entry is reused.
properties.remarks: Mutating the returned list directly will not notify the owning component — use [[SetBulletMarkers]] for replacement, or call uniText.SetDirty(UniTextDirtyFlags.Text) after manual edits.

properties.name: OrderedStyles
properties.summary: Numbering styles indexed by nesting level (level 0 first). When a list item nests deeper than the configured length, the last entry is reused.
properties.remarks: Mutating the returned list directly will not notify the owning component — use [[SetOrderedStyles]] for replacement, or call uniText.SetDirty(UniTextDirtyFlags.Text) after manual edits.

types.name: LowercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to lowercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for lowercase characters. Uses the bundled UCD case mapping table rather than char.ToLowerInvariant to avoid runtime gaps in Mono/IL2CPP.

types.name: MaterialGlyphContext
types.summary: Per-glyph context passed to [[glyphDataWriter]] and [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

fields.name: glyphIndexInSelection
fields.summary: Monotonic 0-based index of this glyph across all ranges selected by this modifier in the current rebuild. Useful for staggered per-glyph animations. Not reset between ranges.

types.name: MaterialModifier
types.summary: Applies a user-authored [[Material]] to a text range by emitting a dedicated sub-mesh with its own CanvasRenderer.
types.remarks: The custom shader must include UniText_Custom.cginc and declare _MainTex as a 2DArray — see Assets/Create/UniText/Custom Material Shader for a working template. The atlas Texture2DArray is bound automatically; per-glyph user data is written into TEXCOORD2 / TEXCOORD3 (see [[constantUv2]], [[constantUv3]], [[glyphDataWriter]] and [[OnWriteGlyphUV]]). Default [[renderOrder]] is [[Replace]]: the base SDF pass is suppressed on the range (face alpha zeroed in the main mesh, which also hides EffectModifier contributions for those glyphs). Use [[Over]] / [[Under]] to keep the base pass and layer the custom material on top/behind. Parameter: optional tint color. Format: <mat=#RRGGBBAA> or <mat=red>. The tint multiplies the vertex color that the shader receives. Ordering note (Replace mode): Replace works by zeroing the face-alpha of affected glyphs in the base mesh during the onGlyph callback. UniText invokes onGlyph subscribers in the order the corresponding [[Style]]s appear in the component's Styles list. If a [[ColorModifier]] / [[GradientModifier]] entry comes after [[MaterialModifier]], it will overwrite the zeroed alpha and the base face will become visible again, defeating Replace. Place [[MaterialModifier]] after any color-writing modifiers in the Styles list.

methods.name: OnWriteGlyphUV
methods.summary: Override to write per-glyph data into the sub-mesh's TEXCOORD2 / TEXCOORD3. Called once per included glyph. Default implementation returns [[constantUv2]] / [[constantUv3]].
methods.remarks: Ignored when [[glyphDataWriter]] is set. Marked virtual instead of abstract so that a basic [[MaterialModifier]] with only inspector-level configuration is usable as-is without subclassing.

properties.name: Material
properties.summary: Gets or sets the custom material. Triggers a mesh rebuild.

properties.name: ConstantUv2
properties.summary: Constant value written to TEXCOORD2 of every glyph vertex in this modifier's sub-mesh. Use this to animate per-text shader parameters (e.g. dissolve progress, hue offset, flicker phase) without going through Material.Set*, which would affect all texts sharing the cached runtime clone of the material.
properties.remarks: Setting triggers a mesh rebuild on the owning UniText so the new UV value reaches the GPU. XYZW layout is defined by the target shader — see its docs.

properties.name: ConstantUv3
properties.summary: Constant value written to TEXCOORD3 of every glyph vertex in this modifier's sub-mesh. See [[ConstantUv2]] — same semantics, second channel.

properties.name: CloneMaterial
properties.summary: When (default), this modifier uses a cached runtime clone of [[Material]] — shader property / keyword writes are isolated from the source asset, batching dedup is preserved, and runtime edits to source.SetColor(...) do not propagate to already-rendered text. When the source material is used directly: runtime edits are visible immediately, but the source's keyword state and _MainTex binding become shared with every other consumer — set keywords via the Toggle properties in the shader or Material.EnableKeyword manually.

properties.name: RenderOrder
properties.summary: Controls how the custom material composes with the base text pass on the modifier's ranges: [[Replace]] suppresses the base pass (face alpha zeroed); [[Over]] / [[Under]] keep the base pass and layer the custom material in front of or behind it.
properties.remarks: Read on the mesh-generation hot path (OnQuadAppended, GetRenderOrder); changing it requeues a mesh rebuild via [[Color]]. Parse and layout caches are reused — only the sub-mesh and base-face alpha get reapplied.

properties.name: SortIndex
properties.summary: Stable sort key within the same [[RenderOrder]] group; lower indices render first. Use to deterministically layer multiple [[MaterialModifier]] instances with the same render order.

properties.name: EmojiMaterial
properties.summary: Optional override material for emoji glyphs in the modifier's ranges. (default) means emoji glyphs are rendered by the base emoji pass and the modifier emits no emoji sub-mesh contribution; assigning a material routes emoji quads through the modifier's sub-mesh bound to the emoji atlas.
properties.remarks: Read in the slot-resolution path (GetMaterialForSlot); changing it changes which atlas/material is bound, so it requeues via [[Material]].

properties.name: QuadPaddingOverride
properties.summary: Outward em-space padding applied to every sub-mesh quad so shader effects (glow, edge halos, distortion) aren't clipped by the glyph's tight bounding box. Negative reads the value from the bound material's _UniTextMeshPadding property (shader-driven default).
properties.remarks: Read in PrepareForParallel ahead of each rebuild; changing it requeues a mesh rebuild via [[Color]].

properties.name: UseVirtualWriter
properties.summary: When true, [[OnQuadAppended]] calls [[OnWriteGlyphUV]] even if [[glyphDataWriter]] is null. Set to in subclasses that override [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

fields.name: glyphDataWriter
fields.summary: Optional per-glyph data writer. Takes precedence over [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

types.name: MaterialRenderOrder
types.summary: Controls how the custom material composes with the base text pass on the range.

fields.name: Replace
fields.summary: Base text pass is suppressed on the range (face alpha zeroed in the main mesh).

fields.name: Over
fields.summary: Custom material renders in front of the base text pass.

fields.name: Under
fields.summary: Custom material renders behind the base text pass.

types.name: MediaWrapper
types.summary: Owns a single inline-flowed RectTransform created by [[InlineMediaModifier{TEntry, TWrapper}]]. Subclasses decide how the instance is created (prefab clone vs fresh GameObject) and how per-frame visual state is applied (sprite/color, prefab-internal rebuild).

methods.name: TryCreate
methods.summary: Creates the underlying [[instance]] RectTransform (and any sibling components). Return to abort creation — e.g. the renderable payload is missing.

methods.name: ApplyContent
methods.summary: Applies per-frame visual state (sprite, tint, etc.) to [[instance]] and its children. Called after the transform has been positioned and sized. No-op for wrappers whose payload is fully owned by an instantiated prefab.

methods.name: OnDestroyed
methods.summary: Optional hook called after [[Destroy]] tears down the instance, for subclass state reset.

types.name: ModifierBufferExtensions
types.summary: Extension methods for working with modifier attribute buffers.

methods.name: HasFlag
methods.summary: Checks if a byte flag is set at the specified index.

methods.name: HasAnyFlags
methods.summary: Checks if any flags are set in the buffer.

methods.name: SetFlagRange
methods.summary: Sets byte flags for a range of indices.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.summary: Checks if a uint value is non-zero at the specified index.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.summary: Gets a uint value or returns 0 if out of bounds.

methods.name: SetValueRange
methods.summary: Sets uint values for a range of indices.

types.name: ObjModifier
types.summary: Embeds UI prefabs (images, icons, custom elements) inline with text. The set of named inline objects available to <obj=name> tags is supplied by an [[IObjProvider]].
types.remarks: Parameter: the name of the object to embed — resolved through [[Provider]]. Built-in providers: [[InlineObjProvider]] (default — inline list on the modifier), [[AssetObjProvider]] (shared [[UniTextObjects]] asset). For dynamic catalogs, implement [[IObjProvider]] directly and raise its [[Changed]] event when the resolution result changes.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named inline objects used by this modifier when resolving <obj=name> tags. disables resolution.

types.name: OrderedMarkerStyle
types.summary: Specifies the numbering style for ordered list markers.

fields.name: Decimal
fields.summary: Decimal numbers (1, 2, 3...)

fields.name: LowerAlpha
fields.summary: Lowercase letters (a, b, c...)

fields.name: UpperAlpha
fields.summary: Uppercase letters (A, B, C...)

fields.name: LowerRoman
fields.summary: Lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii...)

fields.name: UpperRoman
fields.summary: Uppercase Roman numerals (I, II, III...)

types.name: OutlineModifier
types.summary: Applies an outline effect by appending duplicate glyph geometry behind the face. Supports both solid colour and per-vertex gradient outlines via an optional [[IGradientProvider]].
types.remarks: Tag format (strictly positional — empty slots fall back to defaults, matching [[GradientModifier]]): <outline=color-or-gradient,dilate,shape,angle>. <outline> — defaults: colour = #000000FF, dilate = 0.2. <outline=#ff0000> — red, default dilate. <outline=,0.3> — default colour, custom dilate (note the leading comma). <outline=#ff0000,0.3> — both. <outline=rainbow> — gradient (when [[Provider]] is set). <outline=rainbow,0.3,radial,45> — gradient + dilate + shape + angle. <outline=rainbow,,radial,45> — gradient, default dilate, radial, 45°. Slot 0 resolves as a gradient name first (when [[Provider]] is set and the token matches a known gradient) and falls back to colour parsing otherwise — so existing colour tags keep working unchanged when a provider happens to be attached.

properties.name: FixedPixelSize
properties.summary: When, dilate is interpreted in fixed pixels and compensated by the glyph's gradientScale so the outline has a constant on-screen thickness independent of font size. Default — dilate scales with the glyph SDF padding.
properties.remarks: Read on the mesh-generation hot path; changing it requeues a mesh rebuild via [[Color]].

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Optional source of named gradients. When non-, a tag-parameter token that resolves to a known gradient renders this outline range as a per-vertex gradient; otherwise the token is parsed as a colour. disables gradient resolution and the modifier behaves purely as a solid-colour outline.

types.name: ParameterReader
types.summary: Zero-allocation tokenizer for comma-separated modifier parameters. Eliminates manual IndexOf/Slice/Trim boilerplate in modifier parsers.

methods.name: Next
methods.summary: Reads the next comma-delimited token (trimmed). Returns false if no tokens remain.

methods.name: ParseFloat
methods.summary: Parses a span as float using InvariantCulture. For pre-extracted tokens where Next() was already called.

methods.name: NextFloat
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a float. Returns false if missing or unparseable.

methods.name: NextInt
methods.summary: Reads the next token as an int. Returns false if missing or unparseable.

methods.name: NextColor
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a Color32 via [[ColorParsing]]. Returns false if missing or unparseable.

methods.name: NextUnitFloat
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a float with optional unit suffix. Recognizes: 24 (absolute), 150%, 0.5em, +10/-5 (delta). Always uses InvariantCulture.

methods.name: NextString
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a string (allocates). Returns false if missing or empty.

properties.name: IsEmpty
properties.summary: True if there are no more tokens to read.

types.name: ParsedRange
types.summary: Represents a parsed text range with associated tag information.
types.remarks: Used by [[IParseRule]] implementations to communicate which text regions should be affected by modifiers and where tags should be stripped.

methods.name: ParsedRange
methods.summary: Creates a simple range without tag information.

methods.name: ParsedRange
methods.summary: Creates a range with opening and closing tag positions.

methods.name: SelfClosing
methods.summary: Creates a self-closing tag range that inserts content.

properties.name: HasTags
properties.summary: Returns true if this range has associated tags.

properties.name: IsSelfClosing
properties.summary: Returns true if this is a self-closing tag with inserted content.

fields.name: start
fields.summary: Start index of the content (after opening tag).

fields.name: end
fields.summary: End index of the content (before closing tag).

fields.name: tagStart
fields.summary: Start index of the opening tag, or -1 if no tag.

fields.name: tagEnd
fields.summary: End index of the opening tag.

fields.name: closeTagStart
fields.summary: Start index of the closing tag.

fields.name: closeTagEnd
fields.summary: End index of the closing tag.

fields.name: parameter
fields.summary: Parameter extracted from the tag (e.g., color value).

fields.name: insertString
fields.summary: String to insert for self-closing tags.

types.name: PrefabMediaWrapper
types.summary: Wrapper that clones a UI prefab into the host UniText.

types.name: ScriptPositionModifier
types.summary: Applies superscript or subscript formatting to text ranges.
types.remarks: Two-tier approach: Native: activates OpenType 'sups'/'subs' feature via HarfBuzz (proper glyphs). Synthesis: scales down and shifts vertically using OS/2 metrics (fallback). Attribute sbyte encoding: 0 = unchanged, +1 = native super, -1 = native sub, +2 = synth super, -2 = synth sub. Create two styles to support both tags: Style 1: ScriptPositionModifier + TagRule("sup") with defaultParameter = "super" Style 2: ScriptPositionModifier + TagRule("sub") with defaultParameter = "sub"

types.name: ShadowModifier
types.summary: Applies a shadow effect by appending displaced duplicate glyph geometry behind the face.
types.remarks: The shadow is rendered via a duplicate quad offset from the face and tagged with effect UV2 data. All shadow modifiers render in the same CanvasRenderer as the face (back-first in the index buffer), enabling unlimited stacking with no extra submeshes. All parameters come from the tag/rule parameter string. Format: <shadow=#color>, <shadow=dilate,#color>, or <shadow=dilate,#color,offsetX,offsetY,softness>. Defaults: dilate = 0.1, color = black 50% (#00000080), offset = (0.1,-0.1), softness = 0.1.

properties.name: FixedPixelSize
properties.summary: When, dilate, offset, and softness are interpreted in fixed pixels and compensated by the glyph's gradientScale so the shadow has constant on-screen geometry independent of font size. Default — values scale with the glyph SDF padding and font metric factor.

types.name: SizeModifier
types.summary: Applies font size changes to text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: size value with optional unit. 24 — absolute size in pixels 150% — percentage of base font size +10 — relative increase in pixels -5 — relative decrease in pixels

types.name: SmallCapsModifier
types.summary: Renders lowercase letters as small capitals.
types.remarks: Two-tier approach: Native: activates OpenType 'smcp' feature via HarfBuzz (proper small cap glyphs). Synthesis: converts lowercase to uppercase and scales down (fallback for fonts without smcp). Attribute byte encoding: 0 = unchanged, 1 = native smcp, 2 = synthesis.

types.name: SpriteImageWrapper
types.summary: Wrapper that creates a single-Image GameObject on demand.

types.name: SpriteModifier
types.summary: Embeds [[Sprite]] assets inline with text. The set of named sprites available to <sprite=name> tags is supplied by an [[ISpriteProvider]].
types.remarks: Tag syntax: <sprite=name[,colorArg]>. The optional second positional argument controls the rendered color of this occurrence: omitted — use the entry's own [[color]] (the default; keeps atlas/asset colors, matching how raster images are embedded in HTML, iOS NSTextAttachment, Android ImageSpan). i — inherit the host UniText component's [[color]]. Equivalent to CSS currentColor. #RGB/#RRGGBB/#RRGGBBAA or a named color (red, blue, …) — explicit per-occurrence override. Examples: <sprite=heart>, <sprite=heart,i>, <sprite=heart,#FF0000>. The sprite name is resolved through [[Provider]]. Built-in providers: [[InlineSpriteProvider]] (default — inline list on the modifier), [[AssetSpriteProvider]] (shared [[UniTextSprites]] asset). For dynamic catalogs — input-prompt icon services, localisation, item icons — implement [[ISpriteProvider]] directly and raise its [[Changed]] event when the resolution result changes.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named sprites used by this modifier when resolving <sprite=name> tags. disables resolution.

types.name: StrikethroughModifier
types.summary: Renders a horizontal line through the middle of the text (strikethrough effect).
types.remarks: No parameter. The line position is determined by the font's strikethroughOffset property, or calculated from the x-height if not available. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.

types.name: Style
types.summary: Serializable container that links a modifier with its parse rule. Tracks registration state and ownership to prevent bugs.
types.remarks: Note: "Initialized" state (buffers created, events subscribed) is tracked by BaseModifier.IsInitialized and happens lazily on first Apply(). Ownership rules: - Style tracks its owner UniText - Registration fails if already registered to different owner - State resets on deserialization

methods.name: WholeText
methods.summary: Builds a style that applies modifier to the entire text. No [[Rule]] is created — the absence of a rule is interpreted as "no constraint, apply everywhere", and parameter is forwarded to the modifier on every cycle via [[defaultParameter]].

params.name: modifier
params.description: The modifier to apply. Must not be null.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Optional parameter forwarded to the modifier's OnApply.

methods.name: Range
methods.summary: Builds a style that applies modifier to a fixed codepoint range via a [[RangeRule]].

params.name: modifier
params.description: The modifier to apply. Must not be null.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Optional parameter forwarded to the modifier's OnApply.

methods.name: Tag
methods.summary: Builds a style that activates modifier on ranges matched by a rich-text tag <tagName>...</tagName>.

params.name: modifier
params.description: The modifier to apply. Must not be null.

params.name: defaultParameter
params.description: Optional default parameter used when the tag is written without =value.

properties.name: Modifier
properties.summary: Gets or sets the modifier, with proper lifecycle management on hot-swap.

properties.name: Rule
properties.summary: Gets or sets the parse rule, with proper lifecycle management on hot-swap.

properties.name: DefaultParameter
properties.summary: Parameter forwarded to [[Modifier]] when this style has no [[Rule]] (whole-text application). Ignored when [[Rule]] is set — the rule then supplies its own parameter(s) per matched range. The setter auto-dirties the owning component when the style is registered and rule-less.

properties.name: Owner
properties.summary: Gets the UniTextBase that owns this Style.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Returns true if the style is ready for registration. A modifier with no rule is treated as a whole-text application (no constraint = no limit); a rule with no modifier is valid only when the rule is [[IsStandalone]] (protection rules).

properties.name: IsRegistered
properties.summary: Returns true if registered to a UniText.

types.name: StylePreset
types.summary: Shareable, project-asset container of [[Style]] entries that components apply in bulk via [[AddStylePreset]] or via [[GlobalStylePreset]].
types.remarks: Mutating the preset at runtime through [[AddStyle]] / [[RemoveStyle]] / [[ClearStyles]] raises [[Changed]]; every [[UniTextBase]] that has this preset attached (locally or as the global preset) discards its runtime preset copies and re-instantiates from the new contents on the next frame.

methods.name: AddStyle
methods.summary: Appends a style to the preset and raises [[Changed]].

methods.name: RemoveStyle
methods.summary: Removes the first occurrence of style. Returns on success.

methods.name: RemoveStyleAt
methods.summary: Removes the style at the given index and raises [[Changed]].

methods.name: ClearStyles
methods.summary: Removes every style from the preset and raises [[Changed]].

properties.name: Styles
properties.summary: Snapshot view of the contained styles. Mutate via [[AddStyle]] / [[RemoveStyle]] / [[ClearStyles]] so subscribers are notified.

events.name: Changed
events.summary: Raised whenever the preset's styles list is mutated — either through the editor inspector (OnValidate) or programmatically via [[AddStyle]] / [[RemoveStyle]] / [[ClearStyles]]. Subscribers are expected to be idempotent (the event may fire several times in a row on rapid edits).

types.name: SubMeshModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that emit a separate, owner-controlled sub-mesh rendered by its own CanvasRenderer with a user-supplied material (see [[MaterialModifier]]).
types.remarks: Lifecycle per frame: onRebuildStart — own buffers are cleared; any persistent state (e.g. Replace-mode alpha zero'd into base mesh) will be re-applied in the next onGlyph pass. onGlyph — subclass overrides [[ShouldIncludeCurrentGlyph]] and, when true, the base class copies the face quad (4 verts) from the generator into its own per-atlas buffer (SDF atlas vs emoji atlas are kept separate). onCollectSubMeshes — the base class uploads owned buffers into private [[Mesh]] instances and appends up to two entries (text + emoji) to the render-data list, with the material, atlas, order and sort index chosen by the subclass. Compared to [[EffectModifier]], which bakes its duplicates into the same mesh as the face pass, [[SubMeshModifier]] keeps its vertices in isolated local buffers because each sub-mesh is bound to a distinct material and CanvasRenderer.

methods.name: ShouldIncludeCurrentGlyph
methods.summary: Tells the base class whether the glyph currently being emitted by the generator should be copied into this modifier's sub-mesh. Inspect uniText.MeshGenerator fields (currentCluster, faceBaseIdx, font.IsColor, etc.) for the decision.

methods.name: GetMaterialForSlot
methods.summary: Resolves the material for a given slot. Return to skip emitting that slot.

methods.name: GetSortIndex
methods.summary: Stable sort key within the same [[RenderOrder]] group (lower renders first).

methods.name: OnQuadAppended
methods.summary: Called after a glyph's quad is copied into the slot buffers. Override to write custom UV2/UV3 data for the just-appended four vertices, or to modify colors/positions. The four vertices occupy indices [vertexStart, vertexStart + 4) in the slot buffer identified by slot.

params.name: slot
params.description: Text or emoji slot the quad was written to.

params.name: vertexStart
params.description: Index of the first of the four appended vertices in the slot buffer.

params.name: gen
params.description: The current mesh generator (same as uniText.MeshGenerator, passed for convenience).

methods.name: SetSubMeshUv2
methods.summary: Writes a value into UV2 channel for a vertex in the slot buffer (auto-allocates channel).

methods.name: SetSubMeshUv3
methods.summary: Writes a value into UV3 channel for a vertex in the slot buffer (auto-allocates channel).

methods.name: SetSubMeshUv2Quad
methods.summary: Writes the same value to UV2 for all 4 vertices of a quad (indices [vertexStart..+4)).

methods.name: SetSubMeshUv3Quad
methods.summary: Writes the same value to UV3 for all 4 vertices of a quad (indices [vertexStart..+4)).

methods.name: GetSlotColors
methods.summary: Direct access to the slot color buffer for read/write on already-appended vertices.

methods.name: GetSlotVertices
methods.summary: Direct access to the slot vertex buffer for read/write on already-appended vertices.

methods.name: ExpandSubMeshQuad
methods.summary: Expands a 4-vertex quad outward on all sides by delta em-units. Updates both positions and UV0 in sync so the atlas sample stays aligned. Mirror of [[ExpandQuad]] but operates on the sub-mesh slot buffers. No-op for non-positive deltas or when UV0 has not been written yet.

params.name: vertexStart
params.description: Index of the first of the four quad vertices in the slot buffer.

params.name: delta
params.description: Padding to add on each side, in em-units (matches glyph-UV scale).

methods.name: OnBeforeRebuild
methods.summary: Called at the start of every rebuild (before any onGlyph). Override to refresh derived state (e.g. runtime material clones) that depends on the generator's current mode.

types.name: UnderlineModifier
types.summary: Renders an underline below text using the font's underline metrics.
types.remarks: No parameter. The underline position is determined by the font's underlineOffset property. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.

types.name: UnitKind
types.summary: Unit type for values parsed by [[NextUnitFloat]].

types.name: UppercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to uppercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for uppercase characters. Uses the bundled UCD case mapping table rather than char.ToUpperInvariant to avoid runtime gaps in Mono/IL2CPP (e.g. Greek final sigma U+03C2 → Σ).

types.name: VariationModifier
types.summary: Controls variable font axis values per text range.
types.remarks: Parameter: positional axis values in order wght, wdth, ital, slnt, opsz. Use ~ to skip an axis. Each value supports absolute, percentage, or delta: 700 — absolute axis value 150% — percentage of font's default +200 — delta from font's default Examples: 700, ~,80, 700,~,~,-12

types.name: WobbleAnimationModifier
types.summary: Applies a sine-wave wobble animation to text by oscillating glyph vertices vertically.
types.remarks: Each glyph moves up and down based on sin(time * speed + cluster * spread) * amplitude. The modifier continuously triggers mesh rebuilds while active.

types.name: BackslashEscapeRule
types.summary: Escapes a single ASCII punctuation character preceded by \. Example: \* becomes a literal * and is protected from any other parse rule.
types.remarks: Standalone rule — register via [[AddRule]] without a modifier. The escapable set follows CommonMark §2.4 — all ASCII punctuation: !"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^_`{|}~ Only isolated occurrences are protected. A paired inline matcher (e.g. **bold**) that started scanning before an inner \* will not respect the escape — that case requires matchers themselves to skip escaped characters when seeking their closing marker.

types.name: CodeSpanRule
types.summary: Protects content inside backtick-delimited code spans (e.g. `x`, ``x``, ```x```) from being processed by other parse rules. Follows CommonMark §6.1 balanced-run semantics: an N-backtick run is closed by the next N-backtick run of the same length.
types.remarks: Standalone rule — register via [[AddRule]] without a modifier. If no matching closing run is found, the rule does not consume the input (the backticks are treated as literal text). This matches CommonMark's non-forgiving close behavior.

types.name: CompositeParseRule
types.summary: Combines multiple parse rules into a single rule.
types.remarks: Tries each child rule in order until one matches. Useful for grouping related rules or creating reusable rule sets.

fields.name: rules
fields.summary: Child rules to apply in order.

types.name: InlineTagRule
types.summary: [[TagRule]] with HTML void-element semantics: every <tag> or <tag=value> behaves as a single self-closing placeholder, the /> shorthand is no longer required, and any stray </tag> is silently stripped.
types.remarks: Use for inline-media tags (obj, sprite) where range semantics don't apply — the tag is always a single inline insertion, not a wrapper around following text.

types.name: IParseRule
types.summary: Interface for custom text parsing rules that identify modifier application ranges.
types.remarks: Parse rules scan text for markup (XML tags, Markdown, custom markers) and produce [[ParsedRange]] entries that specify where modifiers should be applied. Rules are matched in priority order (highest first). Use higher priority for explicit markup rules (tags, Markdown) and lower priority for auto-detection rules (raw URLs).

methods.name: TryMatch
methods.summary: Attempts to match a pattern starting at the specified index.
methods.returns: Index after the match, or same index if no match.

params.name: results
params.description: List to add parsed ranges to.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.summary: Called after parsing completes to finalize any pending ranges (e.g., unclosed tags).

methods.name: PostParse
methods.summary: Called after tag stripping to add ranges in clean-text space.

methods.name: Reset
methods.summary: Resets the rule state for a new parse operation.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Gets the matching priority. Higher values are matched first. Default is 0. Use positive values for explicit markup, negative for auto-detection.

properties.name: IsStandalone
properties.summary: Indicates whether this rule operates without a modifier (e.g., protection rules like noparse). When, the rule can be registered via UniText.RegisterRule without pairing it with a BaseModifier.

types.name: LineBreakParseRule
types.summary:
Replaces every occurrence of the void
tag with a hard line break.
types.remarks:
Matches
,
, and
case-insensitively, mirroring the HTML void-element contract: there is no closing tag, no nested content, and the element renders nothing of its own. The tag is stripped and a single line-feed (U+000A) is written into the parsed text in its place. Once inserted, the line-feed is consumed by the regular UAX #14 mandatory-break path, so the new line keeps the surrounding paragraph's direction, alignment, and styling — the tag forces a line wrap, not a paragraph reset. Because the rule does not pair with a modifier, it is registered as a standalone rule.

types.name: MarkdownLinkParseRule
types.summary: Parses Markdown-style links: [link text](https://example.com).

types.name: MarkdownListParseRule
types.summary: Parses Markdown-style lists (bulleted and numbered).
types.remarks: Supports unordered lists with -, *, + markers and ordered lists with 1., 2), etc. Nested lists are detected by indentation level. An item ends at the first line break unless the following line is indented deeper than the item's own indent (which extends the item to cover an indented continuation or a nested list). CommonMark-style lazy continuation across non-indented lines is not supported — a non-indented line after an item is treated as a separate paragraph.

fields.name: spacesPerLevel
fields.summary: Number of spaces per indentation level for nested lists.

types.name: MarkdownWrapRule
types.summary: Parses symmetric open/close markers in text (e.g., **text**, ~~text~~).
types.remarks: The marker string is configurable — any string can be used as a marker with any modifier. When [[defaultParameter]] is set, matched ranges use it as the parameter value.

fields.name: marker
fields.summary: The symmetric marker string that wraps the affected text range.

types.name: NoparseTagRule
types.summary: Protects content inside <noparse>...</noparse> from being processed by any other parse rule. The markers themselves are stripped; the content between them appears verbatim in the output.
types.remarks: Standalone rule — register via [[AddRule]] without a modifier. If the closing </noparse> is missing, the remainder of the text is treated as protected (CommonMark-style forgiving close).

types.name: RawUrlParseRule
types.summary: Auto-detects URLs in plain text and converts them to clickable links.
types.remarks: Recognizes schemes: http://, https://, ftp://, ftps://, file://, mailto:, tel:, and www. prefixes. Uses negative priority (-100) to run after explicit markup rules (tags, Markdown), so URLs inside other markup are not detected.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Low priority ensures this runs after explicit markup rules.

types.name: StringParseRule
types.summary: Matches literal string patterns and optionally replaces them.
types.remarks: Useful for custom shortcodes, emoji aliases, or text substitutions. Example: pattern ":)" with replacement "😊".

fields.name: patterns
fields.summary: String patterns to match (case-sensitive).

fields.name: hasReplacement
fields.summary: Whether to replace matched patterns with a custom string.

fields.name: replacement
fields.summary: Replacement string (used when hasReplacement is true).

types.name: TagParseRule
types.summary: Base class for parsing XML-style markup tags (e.g., <b>, <color=#FF0000>).
types.remarks: Derived classes override [[TagName]] to specify the tag name to match. Parameters are always optional: <tag>, <tag=value>, <tag/>, <tag=value/>. Self-closing is purely syntax-driven via />.

properties.name: IsVoid
properties.summary: When, the tag has HTML void-element semantics: every <tag> or <tag=value> form is treated as self-closing (produces a single ￼ placeholder), and a stray </tag> is silently consumed. Use for inline-media tags (obj, sprite) where range semantics don't apply.

types.name: TagRule
types.summary: Universal tag parse rule configured via a serialized tag name. Replaces all individual tag parse rule classes (BoldParseRule, ColorParseRule, etc.).
types.remarks: Parameters are always optional. Self-closing is syntax-driven via />. <tag>text</tag> — range with no parameter <tag=value>text</tag> — range with parameter <tag/> — self-closing, no parameter <tag=value/> — self-closing with parameter When [[defaultParameter]] is set, tags without parameters use it as a fallback. Tags with partial parameters merge with the default (tag values take priority).

types.name: GradientShape
types.summary: Gradient projection mode. [[Linear]] projects vertex positions onto an axis, [[Radial]] uses distance from the range's centre, [[Angular]] sweeps a conic from the centre.

fields.name: fontId
